item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 11/Mar/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a moderate easterly airstream, it will be rather warm during the day over Guangdong today. The northeast monsoon will reach the coastal areas on Sunday night. It will be slightly cooler over the region in the following couple of days. The weather will be mainly fine and dry during the day. With the monsoon moderating gradually in the middle and latter parts of next week, temperatures will rise over the coast of southern China.

R.H. range: 60 - 90 per Cent
